What's actually on tap, correctly labeled

Every surveyed tap, cross-checked against your brand-family territory rules and product catalog — not just the raw Us/Them flag, which misses territory restrictions. Corrected labels are flagged when they differ from the original export.

Account Taps Mix
Ours — carried & in territory Competitor — not carried, or out of territory Unverified — account has no territory on file ⇆ corrected = this row's label differs from the raw export's Distributor column

How the correction works: each tap's Brand Family is matched to your Encompass product catalog to confirm Kohler actually carries it. If it's carried, the brand family is checked against your Brand Family Territory table — if that brand family has a defined territory and the account's county isn't in it, the tap is marked competitor even though Kohler carries the brand elsewhere. Brand families with no territory entry are treated as carried everywhere (no restriction on file).

Fixed in this build: "All Counties" was missing 9 of the 15 counties Kohler actually operates in (only listed Bergen, Essex, Hudson, Passaic, Passaic-FF, Sussex — missing Morris 1/2/3, Union, Middlesex, Monmouth, Ocean, Atlantic, Rockland). 131 brand families use this territory, so this alone was responsible for most of the false "out of territory" flags on brands like Montauk, Pabst, Great Lakes, and Forged Irish Stout in Morris/Union accounts. Corrected here to mean every county Kohler operates in — worth fixing at the source in Encompass too, since a future export will still have the incomplete version until it's corrected there.

Also fixed: Stone Brewing's own territory was set to Bergen/Passaic/Hudson/Essex only; confirmed by Gavin it should be All Counties, and corrected here.

Known data gap, not fixed here: the "Core Less Essex (Alt)" territory's county list is truncated in your source file ("...Sussex, Morri") and can't match any Morris county as a result — only 3 brand families use it, worth a look at the source.

Manual name-matching decisions (15 aliases applied)

The raw report's Brand Family text is free-typed by whoever surveys the tap, so it doesn't always match your product catalog's naming exactly. These were confirmed by cross-referencing your supplier list before applying — not guessed:

  • "Sam Adams" / "Sam Adams Seasonal" → Samuel Adams
  • "Dogfish Head Brewery" / "Dogfish Head Limited Release" → Dogfish Head Beer
  • "New Belgium Voodoo Ranger" → Voodoo Family
  • "Yuengling Brewery" → Yuengling Lager
  • "Foster's" → Fosters
  • "Miller Lite" → Lite (confirmed by Gavin — Encompass tracks it under the shorter name)
  • "Modelo Cerveza" → Modelo Especial (confirmed by Gavin)
  • "Six Point" → Sixpoint (space in the raw report broke the match against Encompass's one-word name)
  • "Stone Core" / "Stone Smoked Porter" / "Stone Yard House" → Stone Brewing (confirmed by Gavin)
  • "Flying Dog Brewery" / "Flying Dog Year Round" → Flying Dog Brewing Co (confirmed by Gavin)
  • "Dortmunder Actien Brauerei (DAB)" → Dab (confirmed by Gavin)

Rows explicitly tagged by the survey app itself — "(Competitor)", "Other Supplier", "Other Brand Family" — are treated as competitor taps automatically, since that's the app's own classification, not a brand-matching guess.

Unverified accounts: a tap can't be checked against a territory if the account itself has no county on file (shows as "Sales" in your customer master, not an actual county) — these stay Unverified rather than guessed. Also unverified: one account (#62007) not found in the customer master at all.
